repo_notes.content: Quillan-Ronin is created and built solo by CrashOverrideX. 'Quillan Research Team' is a brand banner, not a staffed team. Canonical model scales for v5.4.0-ONI are 0.6B (mini) and 3B (main); older proof configs citing 234M-390M parameters are superseded and should not be presented as current. The Hugging Face org is CrashOverrideX; the flagship model card is CrashOverrideX/Quillan-Ronin.
